scope: Private opt-in trusted shared-process executor using stock queue SQL and compiler. Short full-ledger smoke first. Slow and dense are follow-ups. Protected and stock results keep independent labels.
local_gate: Local short, slow, sparse, and dense ledgers passed (128, 512, 24, and 1024 jobs). Every job has two separately committed application rows and token-checked terminal state. The full runtime gate passed (1,595 unit tests plus three library tests, 50 unit cases ignored by default). Separate fault fixture passed timeout, renewal, panic, stop, disconnect, crash before and after effect commit, replacement-token fencing, late direct effect after cancellation, and tenant grants. Require successful native short smoke before timing.
